parts.title: Part 1 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Read each question and answer Yes or No. Press ? if you did not understand. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer; ? scores 0.

items.q: When someone is on a diet, is it healthier for them to lose weight gradually?
When soldiers wave a white flag, does it mean they are ready to go to battle?
Is this sentence correct: “He took part in the rugby match regardless of his injuries”?

parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: around the handle of the racket.
providing you use the correct technique.
The only way to beat a bully
is to stand up for yourself.
on behalf of the local council

parts.text: My recommendation would be to wind tape around the handle of the racket. Don't yawn in the Queen's presence; she'll take offense because it implies you're bored. There's no danger whatsoever of straining a muscle on this exercise machine providing you use the correct technique. The only way to beat a bully is to stand up for yourself. If possible, I'd appreciate a moment of your time. I'm conducting a survey on behalf of the local council to assess public opinion on the new retail development.
